dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Pardon me, <$cdef(27)>. I have a favor to
ask...
Could
I
borrow
you
for
a moment?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Com licença. <$cdef(27)>Tenho um favor a fazer.
perguntar...
Poderia
I
emprestado
você
em vez
Um momento?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>It has to do with my inability to generate electricity.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Tem a ver com a minha incapacidade de gerar electricidade.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>You see, I had something of a little family before—some
younger Pokémon who were frail and feeble, <$voicel(2,8)>so I got in
the habit of sharing my electricity with them.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>sabe, eu já tive uma espécie de família.
Pokémon mais jovem, frágil e fraco, <$voicel(2,8)>Então eu entrei.
o hábito de partilhar a minha electricidade com eles.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>But there came a day when the whole lot of them fell ill
all at once, and <$voicel(2,6)>in response, I took things a bit too far...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>Mas chegou um dia em que todos eles adoeceram.
todos de uma só vez, e <$voicel(2,6)>Em resposta, levei as coisas longe demais...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>I pushed myself to the absolute limit trying to share
even more electricity with them and, well...I couldn’t
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> a single spark after that.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>Eu empurrei-me para o limite absoluto tentando compartilhar
ainda mais eletricidade com eles e, bem... eu não poderia
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> Uma única faísca depois disso.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>If by chance my little family members have also returned
to the area, I would be so delighted to see them again...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Could I trouble you to look for them?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Se por acaso os meus familiares também regressaram
Para a área, eu ficaria tão feliz em vê-los novamente...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Posso incomodá-lo a procurá-los?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Truly? Thank you ever so much!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Muito obrigado!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>In that case, could I ask you to look for <$cdef(27)>Pichu </color>first?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Nesse caso, posso pedir-lhe para procurar <$cdef(27)>Pichu </color>Primeiro?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu was a reliable one, always looking to bear the
burdens of others...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu foi um um confiável, sempre olhando para suportar o
fardos dos outros...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)>But <$cdef(27)>Pichu always craved love and attention the most...
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>I can hardly wait to shower them with affection when
we’re reunited!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)>Mas... <$cdef(27)>Pichu sempre desejou amor e atenção mais...
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Mal posso esperar para os banhar com carinho quando
Estamos reunidos!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>If you do find <$cdef(27)>Pichu, please bring them to me. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>I would be
in your debt.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>Se você encontrar <$cdef(27)>PichuPor favor, traga-os para mim. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>Eu estaria
em dívida para com você.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,7)>Please bring <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color> to me. I shall be in your debt.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,7)>Por favor, tragam-no. <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color> Ficarei em dívida para com você.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>I’m just so worried about my little family members right
now... Please call on me some other time.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Estou tão preocupado com meus pequenos familiares.
Por favor, ligue-me noutra altura.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>What’s up, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>O que está acontecendo, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,9)>What?! <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>’s looking for me? <$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,8)>I gotta go find them!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,9)>O quê? <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>Está à minha procura? <$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,8)>Tenho de ir procurá-los!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Could you please take me to <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Pode levar-me, por favor? <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)><$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>’s always worked real, real hard for us...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)><$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>Sempre trabalhou muito, muito duro para nós...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>I just wanna say thank you and...and that we’re all OK now.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>Eu só quero dizer obrigado e ... e que estamos todos bem agora.

dialogues.en: <$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,859)><$voicel(4,10)><$cdef(27)>PIKACHU</color>! Watch this!
dialogues.pt_br: <$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,859)><$voicel(4,10)><$cdef(27)>PIKACHU</color>Olha para isto!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Why, what a marvelous shock that was!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Ora, que choque maravilhoso!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Heh heh... I’m just so happy to see you!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Heh heh... Estou tão feliz em vê-lo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,5)>Pii-hee-hee, I was shocked! You always used to struggle to
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> electricity in the past. <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>You have truly
grown, my dear <$cdef(27)>Pichu.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,5)>Pii-hee-hee, eu estava chocada!
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> electricidade no passado. <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>tem mesmo
crescida, minha querida <$cdef(27)>Pichu.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>I am so very proud of you.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Estou muito orgulhosa de ti.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$kfacial(4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Thanks, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu! Um, um, while you were gone, <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>I
practiced really, really hard!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$kfacial(4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Obrigado. <$cdef(27)>PikachuEnquanto estiveste fora, <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>I
Praticou muito, muito duro!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>So, now you don’t have to work so hard to look after me!
Thank you so much for everything, and...<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>I hope maybe
now, I can help you out more...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Então, agora você não precisa trabalhar tanto para cuidar de mim!
Muito obrigado por tudo, e...<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>Espero que sim.
Agora, posso ajudar-te mais...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>My dear little <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color>... Thank you.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Minha querida <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color>Obrigado.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Thank you ever so much for reuniting me with <$cdef(27)>Pichu,
<$cdef(27)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Muito obrigado por me reunires com <$cdef(27)>Pichu,
<$cdef(27)>.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Next, could I ask you to bring <$cdef(27)>Toxel</color> to me?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>A seguir, posso pedir-lhe para trazer <$cdef(27)>Toxel</color> Para mim?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Toxel was such a kind, sweet child. <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Always fretting over
me, worrying I was pushing myself too hard...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)><$cdef(27)>Toxel era uma criança tão gentil e doce. <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Sempre a preocupar-se
Eu, preocupado por estar a esforçar-me demasiado...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>They used to be a bit of a loner, and I worry they are off
crying on their own somewhere...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Eles costumavam ser um pouco solitários, e eu me preocupo que eles estão fora
Choravam sozinhas algures...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I am counting on you to reunite me with <$cdef(27)>Toxel,
<$cdef(27)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Estou a contar com você para me reunires com <$cdef(27)>Toxel,
<$cdef(27)>.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,5)>Could you bring <$cdef(27)>Toxel</color> to me? I would be indebted to you.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,5)>pode trazer-me? <$cdef(27)>Toxel</color> Eu ficaria em dívida para com você.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Oh... Um, hi, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>. What’s up?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Olá. <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>O que está acontecendo?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,9)>What...? <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>...? <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,4)>Oh, I sure would like to see them...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,9)>O que...? <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>...? <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,4)>Oh, eu gostaria de vê-los...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Could...could you take me to <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>, please?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>pode levar-me para... <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>Por favor?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>I hope <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>’s doing OK... They work so hard...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Espero que sim. <$cdef(27)>Pikachu</color>Está tudo bem... eles trabalham tanto...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! Thank you so so much for
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>bringing
<$cdef(27)>Toxel
to me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, Oh, <$cdef(27)>Muito obrigado por
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>trazendo
<$cdef(27)>Toxel
Para mim!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Toxel? What’s the matter? Are you still feeling unwell after
all this time?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)><$cdef(27)>Toxel? Qual é o problema? Você ainda está se sentindo mal depois
Todo este tempo?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,2)><$motion(4,826)><$voicel(4,9)>WAAAHHH! <$cdef(27)>PIKACHUUU! I missed you so so SO
much! <$voicel(4,8)>Please don’t go away ever again! Please!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,2)><$motion(4,826)><$voicel(4,9)>Waaahhh! <$cdef(27)>PICACHUUSenti tanto a tua falta.
Muito! <$voicel(4,8)>Por favor, nunca mais vá embora! Por favor!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Toxel</color>! B-be careful! You’re shaking me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Toxel</color>Tenha cuidado! Você está me sacudindo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Oh, I-I’m sorry! I couldn’t help it... I hope I didn’t
hurt you...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Oh, eu-eu sinto muito! Eu não pude evitar... Eu espero que eu não
Magoei-te...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Why, pay it no mind at all. It takes more than that to
harm me.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Não se preocupe, é preciso mais do que isso para
Faz-me mal.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>O-oh, OK... That’s good... <$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>I saw you looking really tired after
you’d given us electricity, and...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Está bem... está bem... <$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Vi-te a olhar muito cansado depois.
você nos deu eletricidade, e...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>I promise I won’t tire you out like that ever again! I’m
gonna protect you, OK?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Eu prometo que eu não vou cansá-lo assim nunca mais!
Vou proteger-te, está bem?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>Toxel... Thank you. You’re still the sweetheart I
remember you as.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, Oh, <$cdef(27)>Toxel... Obrigado. Você ainda é a querida
Lembra-te de ti.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>You’ve reunited me with both <$cdef(27)>Pichu and <$cdef(27)>Toxel... I am <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>truly
in your debt.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Você me reuniu com ambos <$cdef(27)>Pichu e <$cdef(27)>ToxelEu sou. <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>verdadeiramente
em dívida para com você.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Lastly, could I impose upon you to bring me <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Por último, posso impor-lhe que me traga <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color>?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Dedenne was quite the curious one, always running off to
explore all sorts of places.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Dedenne foi bastante curioso, sempre correndo para
explorar todos os tipos de lugares.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)>And they brought me so many presents from their little
escapades. <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Pii-hee! Why, those were the days...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)>E trouxeram-me tantos presentes dos seus pequenos
Escapas. <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>Pii-hee, aqueles eram os dias...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Once <$cdef(27)>Dedenne is here, our whole little family will be
together again. I’m counting on you,
<$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Uma vez <$cdef(27)>Dedenne está aqui, toda a nossa pequena família estará
Eu estou contando com você,
<$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Please bring <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color> to me. I’ll be in your debt.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Por favor, tragam-no. <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color> para mim. Eu estarei em dívida com você.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! What’s wrong, bestie?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>O que se passa, amiga?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,9)>WHAT?! <$cdef(27)>PIKACHU </color>is looking for me?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,9)>O quê? <$cdef(27)>PIKACHU </color>está à minha procura?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,7)>I gotta see them RIGHT now! Come on, what are you
waiting for?! We have to GO! Lead the way! AHHH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,7)>Tenho de vê-los agora!
Esperar?! Temos que ir! Mostre o caminho!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>I can’t wait to see <$cdef(27)>PIKACHU</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Mal posso esperar para ver <$cdef(27)>PIKACHU</color>!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$kfacial(4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>Pikachu is seriously the greatest! So amazing, so nice, so
beautiful... <$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>And so dang COOL!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$kfacial(4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>Pikachu é realmente o maior! Tão incrível, tão agradável, então
Lindo... <$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,10)>E tão fixe!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>What should I even say when I see <$cdef(27)>Pikachu again?! There’s
SOOO much that I want to tell them!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>O que devo dizer quando vir <$cdef(27)>Pikachu novamente?! Há
O que eu quero dizer-lhes!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,9)><$cdef(27)>PIKACHUUU! It’s been FOR—E—VER! I missed you
SOOO much!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,9)><$cdef(27)>PICACHUU! Tem sido para - E - Ver! Senti sua falta
Muito!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Why, my dearest <$cdef(27)>Dedenne! It truly has been quite
some time.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Por que, minha querida <$cdef(27)>DedenneTem sido realmente bastante
Algum dia.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(5,14)><$facial(5,1)><$motion(5,805)><$voicel(5,5)>Yeah, it really has!
... ... ...
Uhhh...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(5,14)><$facial(5,1)><$motion(5,805)><$voicel(5,5)>Sim, foi mesmo!
... ... ...
Uhhh...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Is something troubling you?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Há alguma coisa que te incomoda?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(5,4)><$facial(5,9)><$motion(5,807)><$voicel(5,5)>Dang, I just have SO many things I want to tell you! <$comeff(5,7)><$motion(5,802)><$voicel(5,8)>Argh!
I’m all jumbled up! I don’t even know where to BEGIN!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(5,4)><$facial(5,9)><$motion(5,807)><$voicel(5,5)>Bolas, tenho tantas coisas para te dizer! <$comeff(5,7)><$motion(5,802)><$voicel(5,8)>Argh!
Eu estou todo confuso! Eu nem sei por onde começar!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Pii-hee! Take all the time you need, <$cdef(27)>Dedenne. <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>I’m glad to
see you so full of energy—that rambunctiousness suits you.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Pii-hee, leva o tempo que precisares. <$cdef(27)>Dedenne. <$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Fico feliz em
E vê-lo tão cheio de energia, que a rambunciosidade combina com você.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,9)>Hehehe, yup, that’s me! Full blast, all day every day! And I
don’t even need to steal your electricity to get all
charged up anymore!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,9)>Hehehe, yup, que sou eu! Explosão total, todos os dias todos os dias! E eu
nem mesmo precisa roubar sua eletricidade para obter todos
Mais carregados!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(5,3)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,7)>So promise me you’ll use the electricity YOU make just for
YOURSELF! <$comeff(5,9)><$motion(5,806)><$voicel(5,10)>’Cause you can make a whole bunch of it!
Unlike, uhhh—some of us!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(5,3)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,7)>Então me prometa que você vai usar a eletricidade que você faz apenas para
Tu mesmo! <$comeff(5,9)><$motion(5,806)><$voicel(5,10)>Porque você pode fazer um monte dele!
Ao contrário de alguns de nós!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,5)>Why, <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color>, I... *sniff*
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,5)>Porquê? <$cdef(27)>Dedenne</color>, I... * sniff *

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,7)>H-hey! How come <$cdef(27)>Dedenne gets all the attention? I wanna
talk to you too, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,7)>Porque é que... <$cdef(27)>Dedenne Eu quero...
Também falo com você. <$cdef(27)>Pikachu...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(6,10)><$motion(6,803)><$voicel(6,9)>Yeah! I wanna talk too!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(6,10)><$motion(6,803)><$voicel(6,9)>Eu também quero falar!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(5,3)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,9)>Whoa! It’s <$cdef(27)>Toxel </color>and <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color>! Long time no see!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(5,3)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,9)>Uau! É <$cdef(27)>Toxel </color>e <$cdef(27)>Pichu</color>Há quanto tempo!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)><$kfacial(2)>Oh, this is just like the old days...and we have you to
thank, <$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)><$kfacial(2)>Isto é como nos velhos tempos... e nós temos-te a ti.
Obrigado, <$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Well then, now that we’re all gathered, I have something
to show you all. <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Give me just a moment to prepare...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, então, agora que estamos todos reunidos, eu tenho algo
para vos mostrar a todos. <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Dê-me só um momento para me preparar...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>All right, here I go.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>Muito bem, aqui vou eu.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Oh wow... So sparkly!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Tão brilhante!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(5,9)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,10)>I knew you had it in you! That is BEAUTIFUL! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(5,9)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,803)><$voicel(5,10)>Eu sabia que tinhas isso em ti!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Chu! I’m happy you enjoyed it.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Chu! Estou feliz que você gostou.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(6,21)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,806)><$voicel(6,9)>I hope I can make that much electricity someday...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(6,21)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,806)><$voicel(6,9)>Espero poder fazer tanta electricidade algum dia...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Pii-hee, I am quite certain you all will one day.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Pii-hee, tenho a certeza de que todos irão um dia.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,801)><$voicel(6,9)>Really?! Then I’m gonna practice <$spwicon(9)><$cdef(27)>generating
every day!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,801)><$voicel(6,9)>Sério?! Então eu vou praticar <$spwicon(9)><$cdef(27)>gerando
Todos os dias!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>M-me too...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>Eu também...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,10)>And me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,10)>E eu!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Before I forget... Could I ask one last favor of you,
<$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Antes que me esqueça, posso pedir-lhe um último favor?
<$cdef(27)>?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)>Would you please keep the fact <$voicel(2,6)>that I cannot <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)>
my own electricity between us?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)>Pode, por favor, manter o fato? <$voicel(2,6)>que eu não posso <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)>
A minha própria electricidade entre nós?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>For now, I just want them to keep seeing me as the
Pokémon they can rely upon for anything.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>Por agora, só quero que eles continuem a ver-me como o
Pokémon podem confiar em qualquer coisa.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh dear, they aren’t in this area, either? What to do, what
to do...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh querida, eles não estão nesta área, também? O que fazer, o que
Para fazer...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>I’m actually looking for some little friends of mine...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Na verdade, estou procurando alguns amiguinhos meus...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>If you happen to be free, could I trouble you to <$voicel(2,7)>guide me
to <$cdef(27)><$stgname;1(2)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>Se acontecer de seres livre, posso incomodar-te? <$voicel(2,7)>guia-me
para <$cdef(27)><$stgname;1(2)>?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Could I trouble you to guide me to
<$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(2)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Posso incomodá-lo a guiar-me para
<$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(2)>?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Hmmm... I’m still not seeing them anywhere.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Hmmm... Eu ainda não estou vendo eles em qualquer lugar.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Pardon me, <$cdef(27)>. Could I borrow
you
for
a moment?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Com licença. <$cdef(27)>Posso pedir emprestado?
você
em vez
Um momento?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>It has to do with my inability to generate electricity.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Tem a ver com a minha incapacidade de gerar electricidade.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>When I first woke up, I couldn’t quite recall the reason
why my electricity was gone...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Quando acordei pela primeira vez, não conseguia me lembrar bem da razão
Porque é que a minha electricidade se foi...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>But the more time I spend here, the more my memory has
returned in little bits and pieces. <$voicel(2,7)>And I’ve recalled
an important memory from long ago.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Mas quanto mais tempo passo aqui, mais a minha memória tem.
voltou em pedacinhos. <$voicel(2,7)>E eu me lembrei
uma memória importante de há muito tempo.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>You see, I had something of a little family before—some
younger Pokémon who were frail and feeble, <$voicel(2,8)>so I got in
the habit of sharing my electricity with them.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,5)>sabe, eu já tive uma espécie de família.
Pokémon mais jovem, frágil e fraco, <$voicel(2,8)>Então eu entrei.
o hábito de partilhar a minha electricidade com eles.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>But there came a day when the whole lot of them fell ill
all at once, and <$voicel(2,6)>in response, I took things a bit too far...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,10)>Mas chegou um dia em que todos eles adoeceram.
todos de uma só vez, e <$voicel(2,6)>Em resposta, levei as coisas longe demais...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>I pushed myself to the absolute limit trying to share
even more electricity with them and, well...I couldn’t
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> a single spark after that.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>Eu empurrei-me para o limite absoluto tentando compartilhar
ainda mais eletricidade com eles e, bem... eu não poderia
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> Uma única faísca depois disso.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>If by chance my little family members have also returned
to the area, I would be so delighted to see them again...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Could I trouble you to look for them?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Se por acaso os meus familiares também regressaram
Para a área, eu ficaria tão feliz em vê-los novamente...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Posso incomodá-lo a procurá-los?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Truly? Thank you ever so much!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Muito obrigado!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>In that case, could I ask you to look for <$cdef(27)>Pichu </color>first?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Nesse caso, posso pedir-lhe para procurar <$cdef(27)>Pichu </color>Primeiro?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu was a reliable one, always looking to bear the
burdens of others...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>Pichu foi um um confiável, sempre olhando para suportar o
fardos dos outros...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,5)>But <$cdef(27)>Pichu always craved love and attention the most...
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>I can hardly wait to shower them with affection when
we’re reunited!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$facial(2,5)>Mas... <$cdef(27)>Pichu sempre desejou amor e atenção mais...
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Mal posso esperar para os banhar com carinho quando
Estamos reunidos!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>If you do find <$cdef(27)>Pichu, please bring them to me. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>I would be
in your debt.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)><$facial(2,1)>Se você encontrar <$cdef(27)>PichuPor favor, traga-os para mim. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>Eu estaria
em dívida para com você.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>When I first woke up, I couldn’t quite recall the reason
why my electricity was gone...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Quando acordei pela primeira vez, não conseguia me lembrar bem da razão
Porque é que a minha electricidade se foi...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>But the more time I spend here, the more my memory has
returned in little bits and pieces. <$voicel(2,7)>And I’ve recalled
an important memory from long ago.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Mas quanto mais tempo passo aqui, mais a minha memória tem.
voltou em pedacinhos. <$voicel(2,7)>E eu me lembrei
uma memória importante de há muito tempo.
